\maketitle
For the current operators we have 

\[
\bm{J}_{N}^{0}=-i\sum_{ij\sigma}t_{ij}\left(\bm{r}_{i}-\bm{r}_{j}\right)p_{i\sigma}^{\dagger}p_{j\sigma}
\]

\[
\bm{J}_{N}^{1}=-i\sum_{ilj\beta\alpha}\frac{2g_{il}g_{jl}}{U}\left(\bm{r}_{i}-\bm{r}_{j}\right)p_{i\alpha}^{\dagger}\left(\bm{S}_{l}\cdot\bm{\sigma}_{\alpha\beta}\right)p_{j\beta}
\]

\[
\bm{J}_{N}^{2}=i\sum_{ilj\beta\alpha}\frac{2\lambda g_{il}g_{jl}}{U}\left(X_{il}+X_{jl}\right)\left(\bm{r}_{i}-\bm{r}_{j}\right)p_{i\alpha}^{\dagger}\left(\bm{S}_{l}\cdot\bm{\sigma}_{\alpha\beta}\right)p_{j\beta}
\]

\begin{align*}
\bm{J}_{N}^{2} & =i\sum_{ilj\beta\alpha}\frac{2\lambda g_{jl}g_{il}}{U}\left(X_{il}\right)\left(\bm{r}_{j}-\bm{r}_{i}\right)p_{j\alpha}^{\dagger}\left(\bm{S}_{l}\cdot\bm{\sigma}_{\alpha\beta}\right)p_{i\beta}\\
 & =-i\sum_{ilj\beta\alpha}\frac{2\lambda g_{il}g_{jl}}{U}\left(X_{il}\right)\left(\bm{r}_{i}-\bm{r}_{j}\right)p_{j\alpha}^{\dagger}\left(\bm{S}_{l}\cdot\bm{\sigma}_{\alpha\beta}\right)p_{i\beta}
\end{align*}

\[
\bm{J}_{N}^{2}=i\sum_{ilj\beta\alpha}\frac{2\lambda g_{il}g_{jl}}{U}\left(\bm{r}_{i}-\bm{r}_{j}\right)X_{il}\left(\bm{S}_{l}\cdot\bm{\sigma}_{\alpha\beta}\right)\left(p_{i\alpha}^{\dagger}p_{j\beta}-p_{j\alpha}^{\dagger}p_{i\beta}\right)
\]
